Each week we'll have a Coaching Corner thread on qutee - https://www.qutee.com/q/week-1-megathread-introducing-coaching-corner/ (top comment explains everything or watch the end of the video)
Youtube isn't a good platform to actually get help which is why we'll use Qutee. Ask questions, answer other people's questions if you know them, talk about this episode or things you need help with and I'll be picking 1 or 2 people each week to have there games looked at!

Make sure you follow me on Qutee as well so you get notified when the new thread is up!
